description: Browse the perfume houses and fragrance brands in the 10ML Fragrance Index with country, type (designer, niche, middle-eastern, indie, celebrity), perfumes profiled and what each is known for. Filter by type, country or a name fragment. Use when someone wants to explore brands, find niche or Middle Eastern houses, or see which houses are covered. Not for one house's full profile (use get_house) and not for perfumes (use search_perfumes).

country.description: Only houses from this country, e.g. "France", "Italy", "United Arab Emirates"

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

query.description: Part of a house name, e.g. "tom" or "maison"

name: list_houses
title: List perfume houses
